title: QALD-9-plus: Multilingual Question Answering Dataset
summary: This community centers on the QALD-9-plus dataset, a resource designed for multilingual question answering over DBpedia and Wikidata. The dataset was introduced in a paper authored by Aleksandr Perevalov, Dennis Diefenbach, Ricardo Usbeck, and Andreas Both. The work was published at the 16th IEEE International Conference on Semantic Computing (ICSC 2022).
key_findings: The QALD-9-plus dataset is specifically designed for question answering tasks over DBpedia and Wikidata.
A distinguishing feature of the dataset is that it was translated by native speakers to ensure multilingual quality.
The dataset was formally introduced in the paper 'QALD-9-plus: A Multilingual Dataset for Question Answering over DBpedia and Wikidata Translated by Native Speakers'.
The research was published in the proceedings of the 16th IEEE International Conference on Semantic Computing (ICSC 2022).
The paper was authored by a team consisting of Aleksandr Perevalov, Dennis Diefenbach, Ricardo Usbeck, and Andreas Both.
The conference took place in Laguna Hills, CA, USA, from January 26-28, 2022.
